title: Bloomberg TV’s The Close: Luke Sarsfield on Q2 2026 Earnings and Ongoing Opportunity
summary: Ridgepost Capital Chairman and CEO Luke Sarsfield recently joined Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg Television’s The Close.
body_markdown:
Ridgepost Capital Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Luke Sarsfield recently joined Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg Television’s The Close. Luke discussed why the middle and lower-middle market remains one of the most attractive areas within the private markets.


[Watch the video on YouTube.](https://youtu.be/hYQRuYwr1vE)
